Ex-Referee Mike Dean Admits to 'Secret Games' During Premier League Matches

Former Premier League referee Mike Dean has admitted to playing 'secret games' during matches, a revelation that has sparked backlash and calls for investigation. Dean stated on a podcast that he and other officials would sometimes see how long they could go without blowing the whistle, describing it as a 'game' and a way to impress linesmen. This admission has drawn criticism from former referees and pundits, with some calling his claims 'nonsense' and urging the Football Association (FA) to investigate. Dean has since released a statement responding to the controversy.
